column4: Inland Revenue (Amendment)
Act, No. 19 of 2009
Section 217 of the principal enactment as amended

column3: by Act, No. 9 of 2008, is hereby further amended as follows:—

column4: by  the  repeal  of  the  definition  of  the  phrase
“approved by the Commissioner-General”, and the
substitution therefor of the following definition:—
‘ “approved by the Commissioner-General” when
used  in  relation  to  a  pension,  provident,
gratuity  or  savings  fund  means,  approved
by the Commissioner-General as conforming
to  such  conditions  as  may  be  specified  by
him,  either  generally  or  specifically  in
relation  to  any  such  fund,  by  notice
published  in  the  Gazette,  having  regard  to
the need for the protection of the interests of
the  contributors  to  any  such  fund  and  the
protection of revenue;’; and
by the insertion immediately after the definition of
the  word  “Assessor”,  of  the  following  new
definition:—
‘ “associate  company”  means  a  company  over
which an investing company has a significant
influence and which is neither a subsidiary
of  the  investing  company  nor  is  a  joint
venture of which the investing company is a
partner;’.
The  First  Schedule  to  the  principal  enactment  is
by the substitution in Part I of that Schedule, for
the words “Any individual other than an individual
referred to in Part II or Part III”, of the words and
figures “For any year of assessment ending on or
before March 31, 2009, any individual other than
an individual referred to in Part II or Part III”; and
